name: AK Medical Holdings Limited
summary: AK Medical Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, designs, develops, produces, and markets orthopedic joint implants and related products in the People's Republic of China, the United Kingdom, and internationally. It offers knee, hip, and spinal and trauma replacement implants; and 3D-printed products, such as 3D-printed hip and knee replacement implants, 3D-printed spinal and trauma implants, as well as customized joint, pelvic, spinal and trauma implant products and customized value-added surgical services and orthopedic surgical robots.
